The Dev Guild recovery Safe passes every reviewed live condition. The Green Goods protocol recovery Safe 0x1B9Ac97Ea62f69521A14cbe6F45eb24aD6612C19 does not: live threshold is 1 against the hard floor of 2, and its live 4-owner set is a strict subset of the 6 owners frozen in config/commitment-pooling-release.json. Implementation, review, release, guardian trust, Safe deployment, and value activation remain separate authorization boundaries.
Use Bun wrappers only; never raw Forge.

Afo accepted the live 1-of-4 Green Goods recovery Safe for this release and directed that it is not a blocker. The accepted configuration is recorded as GREEN_GOODS_ACCEPTED_RECOVERY_CONFIGURATION in script/deploy/garden-safe-owners.ts next to the existing DEV_GUILD_REVIEWED_OWNERS constant, and assertRecoverySafeConfiguration now takes a caller-declared minimum threshold that still defaults to the reviewed 2-of-N policy. The release manifest stays unmodified because its hash is the release lock for an already-broadcast Arbitrum pool-backfill lane. The final Garden Safe plan returns zero blockers across all 18 boundaries. Accepted risk: one of the four Green Goods signers plus any other owner reaches the Garden Safe threshold of two.
